description.zh: 指定新创建数据库账户的名称。最多支持128字符。
description.en: The username of the database account to be created. The username can be up to 128 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要创建账户的数据库实例ID。
> 您可以调用[ListDatabaseAccounts](~~2758839~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the database for which you want to create a database account.

> You can call the [ListDatabaseAccounts](~~2758839~~) operation to query the database account ID.

description.zh: 数据库名。当DatabaseId对应的Database为Postgres和Oracle时，DatabaseSchema为必填。
description.en: The name of the database. This parameter is required for PostgreSQL and Oracle databases.

description.zh:
要新建数据库账户的堡垒机实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a database account.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
登录属性，Oracle类型数据库必须指定，取值：
- SERVICENAME
- SID
description.en:
The logon attribute. This parameter is required for Oracle databases. Valid values:

- SERVICENAME

- SID

description.zh: 指定新建数据库账户的密码。
description.en: The password of the database account to be created.

description.zh:
要新建数据库账户的堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a database account.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

title.zh: 为指定数据库实例创建数据库账户

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-database-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-id 3 --database-account-name root --password MCQ000000 --database-schema orcl --login-attribute SID --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateDatabaseAccount --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a' --LoginAttribute SID --DatabaseId 3 --DatabaseAccountName root --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Password MCQ000000 --DatabaseSchema orcl
